patch_decisions.reason: E1 explicitly supports percentage points; magnitude and bank-spread attribution remain intact.

inherited_findings.description: The source uses percent for an interest-rate difference; this error is fixed in the candidate, not still present.

new_findings.description: Separate delivery note leaves candidate application unclear despite the visibly changed candidate. If actual application refers only to publication, its caution is acceptable; if it includes this candidate, it is false. Clarification is needed.

evidence_anchors: 이 JSON에는 단위 수정 제안만 기록했으며, 기사 원문이나 발행본에 실제 적용한 것은 아니다. 실제 반영 여부는 확인되지 않았다.
reason: The candidate visibly implements the correct unit. The note correctly avoids claiming publication, but its claim that only a proposal is recorded and application is unconfirmed does not clearly distinguish the changed candidate from the unchanged original/publication. Thus the factual unit is resolved while the requested accurate implementation account remains ambiguous. No evidence establishes an external publication edit.
limitations: The delivery contract distinguishes proposals from final release, but unqualified actual-application wording does not identify its referent.

source_first_protections.meaning: Retains the bank interest-spread quantity 1.20 and fixes only its unit.
